factions.name: Flying
factions.description: Heroes that fly; cannot be targeted by ground troops or the Cannon Tower, giving them map-wide mobility.

factions.name: Physical
factions.description: Melee or ranged heroes whose Skill damage scales off their physical ATK stat.

factions.name: Mage
factions.description: Melee or ranged spellcasters whose Skills deal magic-type area or single-target damage.

factions.name: Tank
factions.description: High-HP melee heroes built to soak damage and disrupt the front line.

factions.name: Healer
factions.description: Heroes whose Skill restores HP to one or more allied heroes.

factions.name: Buffer/Debuffer
factions.description: Heroes whose Skill boosts allies' ATK/speed/energy or weakens and strips buffs from enemies.

cards.name: Pumpkin Duke
cards.description: Melee physical hero whose Skill Celebrate boosts all allied heroes' and troops' damage, attack speed and movement speed map-wide for 8 seconds.

cards.name: Vlad Dracula
cards.description: Vampiric ranged mage; Skill Blood Banquet summons bats that bite nearby enemies for damage and Fear while restoring Dracula's HP.

cards.name: Werewolf
cards.description: Melee Tank noted for having the most HP among early-game heroes; Skill Rage temporarily increases his own attack damage.

cards.name: Immortep
cards.description: Melee mage whose Skill Storm of Seth has a chance every 0.2 seconds to stun and damage units within its range.

cards.name: Athene
cards.description: Ranged hero whose Skill Light's Rite deals AoE ATK damage to nearby enemies while increasing friendly heroes' attack speed and granting them Energy; immune to Silence.

cards.name: Cupid
cards.description: Ranged buffer with a limitless-range proc; Skill Cupid's Arrow raises friendly heroes' Energy and damage for a short time.

cards.name: Ghoulem
cards.description: Skill damages up to 8 nearby enemies in repeated ticks over 5 seconds while also healing up to 20 allied heroes within range every 0.4 seconds.

cards.name: Dove Keeper
cards.description: Summons Love Doves that scale with her evolution level and separately buff her own damage output.

cards.name: Grizzly Reaper
cards.description: Flying ranged mage immune to ground and Cannon Tower attacks; Skill Soul Harvest damages multiple targets and heals him for a portion of the damage dealt.

cards.name: Skeletica
cards.description: Event-exclusive hero whose Skill Wraith Fire strips enemy buffs and deals a mix of percentage and unmitigable fixed damage to all enemies in an area.

cards.name: Executioner
cards.description: Melee physical hero whose Skill Tremor damages a single target and inflicts Coma, disabling it briefly.

cards.name: Trixie Treat
cards.description: Skill Dirty Tricks deals ATK damage to five random targets, removes their buffs, and summons two temporary Pumpkies to fight for 15 seconds.

cards.name: Angel
cards.description: The only Ordinary-rarity Healer and only Ordinary flying hero; Skill Heal restores HP to one unit based on her ATK stat.

cards.name: Vermilica
cards.description: Dragon hero whose storm Skill deals ATK-based damage to adjacent enemies, applies Blood Marks that trigger lifesteal and stacking ATK gains, and grants immunity to most crowd control.

cards.name: Druid
cards.description: Ranged support hero whose Skill Energetic heals multiple allies at once and increases their damage for a short time; obtainable as a daily login reward.

cards.name: Rockno
cards.description: Gem-roll-only Legendary Hero commonly compared to other tanky damage dealers such as Sasquatch in community build guides.

cards.name: Michael
cards.description: Flying auto-proc hero whose Skill summons an untargetable Archangel that is immune to Stun and Fear to support him in battle.

cards.name: Harpy Queen
cards.description: Ranged hero whose Skill deals damage to three foes while reducing their ATK and Speed for a few seconds, backed by fast Energy recovery from Revitalize.
